title: Remote Deployment: Send a Plan Straight to Another Site | Orchard Core
description:
Moving content and configuration to another Orchard Core site by hand means downloading a deployment package from one site and importing it into the other.

The Remote Deployment module sends a deployment plan straight to another site. The destination site keeps a remote client, the source site keeps a remote instance, and a shared client name and Api Key connect them. Executing the plan builds the package, sends it, and the destination imports it at once.

In this video:
• How remote deployment works
• Create a remote client on the destination site
• Create a remote instance on the source site
• Execute a plan on the remote instance
• Check the destination
• Security and troubleshooting
